name: Harumo Kanon
source:
An earnest junior who came to study alchemy, Kanon takes everything seriously.
Unfortunately, that very seriousness and her sensibleness tend to backfire, leaving her at the mercy of the group's whims.
Rare for the times, she pursues alchemy entirely of her own accord.
Yet, she's never once managed to pull off a successful transmutation.
It's a failure she frets over just as much as she frets over the size of her chest.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]+Kagami Games' stream]
